newsitem.title: CHINA: Daimler-Benz unit in $95.5 mln China deal.
newsitem.headline: Daimler-Benz unit in $95.5 mln China deal.

text.p: Germany's Daimler-Benz AG car making unit and Yangzhou Motor Coach Manufacturer General signed an agreement on Monday to set up a $95.5 million venture to manufacture chassis for coaches and buses.
The unit, Mercedes Benz AG and Yangzhou will each hold a 50 percent stake in the new venture, officials of the two companies said.
The venture, in Yangzhou in eastern Jiangsu province, will have the production capacity for 7,000 tourists buses and 12,000 chassis a year, they said.

The joint venture, Yaxing-Benz Ltd, hopes to break even in three years, Peter Fietzek, board member of Mercedes Benz, responsible for eastern hemisphere divisions, told a news conference. The duration of the joint venture is 30 years.
